title: triad verify stage — one refutation verdict
description: Structured output contract for a single refute agent judging a single finding. Mirrors the bar in refute.md — do not add fields here without updating that prompt to match.

refuted.description: true kills the finding. Default to true when the defect could not be established — uncertainty is a refutation, not a survival.

ground.description: Which kill condition landed, or survived if none did.

basis.description: The receipt: the file:line read, the guard found and where it is, or the decision-log entry cited. Required for every verdict including refusals — 'seems unlikely' is not a basis.

repro.description: Required when refuted is false: the concrete input or sequence, and the wrong outcome. If this sentence cannot be written, the verdict is refuted.
